EdwCustomTableConfig.CreateViewQuery:
CREATE VIEW [InternationalLogistics].[vw_GRP__ConsolidationShipmentsMastersHouse] WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
SELECT shpLink.ConsolidationKey as JK, SUM(CASE WHEN shp.ShipmentType IN ('STD', 'HLS') AND masLink.ConsolidationID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as Shipments, SUM(CASE WHEN shp.ShipmentType IN ('ASM', 'BCN', 'CLD', 'CLB') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as Masters, SUM(CASE WHEN shp.ShipmentType IN ('STD', 'HLS') AND masLink.ConsolidationID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as House FROM InternationalLogistics.BAS__ConsolidationShipmentPivot shpLink JOIN InternationalLogistics.BAS__Shipment shp ON shp.ShipmentKey = shpLink.ShipmentKey LEFT JOIN InternationalLogistics.BAS__ConsolidationShipmentPivot masLink ON masLink.ConsolidationKey = shpLink.ConsolidationKey AND masLink.ShipmentKey = shp.ColoadMasterShipmentKey WHERE shp.IsCancelled = 0 GROUP BY shpLink.ConsolidationKey
